  primary key user_wallet_acs_store_pkey (event_number bigint)
  user_wallet_acs_store_sid_mid_glt_gls (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, governance_lock_type text, governance_lock_subject text) where governance_lock_type IS NOT NULL
  user_wallet_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_en (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, event_number bigint)
  user_wallet_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_exp (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, contract_expires_at bigint) where contract_expires_at IS NOT NULL
  user_wallet_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_rcr (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, reward_coupon_round bigint) where reward_coupon_round IS NOT NULL
  user_wallet_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_rcv (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, transfer_preapproval_receiver text) where transfer_preapproval_receiver IS NOT NULL
  unique user_wallet_acs_store_store_id_migration_id_contract_id_idx (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, contract_id text)

user_wallet_txlog_store
  user_wallet_txlog_store_archcoupon_sid_en (store_id integer, entry_number bigint desc) where tx_log_id = 'dev'::text AND entry_type = 'fca'::text
  user_wallet_txlog_store_createdcoupon_sid_dccid (store_id integer, development_fund_coupon_contract_id text) where tx_log_id = 'dev'::text AND entry_type = 'fcc'::text
  primary key user_wallet_txlog_store_pkey (entry_number bigint)
  unique user_wallet_txlog_store_si_ti_ei_key (store_id integer, tx_log_id text, event_id text)
  user_wallet_txlog_store_sid_mid_did_rt (store_id integer, migration_id integer, domain_id text, record_time bigint)
  user_wallet_txlog_store_sid_tid (store_id integer, tracking_id text) where tracking_id IS NOT NULL
  user_wallet_txlog_store_store_id_entry_type_idx (store_id integer, entry_type text)
  user_wallet_txlog_store_store_id_migration_id_domain_id_rec_idx (store_id integer, migration_id integer, domain_id text, record_time bigint)

validator_acs_store
  primary key validator_acs_store_pkey (event_number bigint)
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_en (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, event_number bigint)
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_exp (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, contract_expires_at bigint) where contract_expires_at IS NOT NULL
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_pp (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, provider_party text) where provider_party IS NOT NULL
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_tdi (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, traffic_domain_id text) where traffic_domain_id IS NOT NULL
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_un (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, user_name text) where user_name IS NOT NULL
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_up (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, user_party text) where user_party IS NOT NULL
  validator_acs_store_sid_mid_pn_tid_vp (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, package_name text, template_id_qualified_name text, validator_party text) where validator_party IS NOT NULL
  unique validator_acs_store_store_id_migration_id_contract_id_idx (store_id integer, migration_id bigint, contract_id text)

votes_store_results
  primary key votes_store_results_id_pkey (store_id integer, record_time bigint, event_number integer)
  votes_store_sid_effat_rt_en (store_id integer, COALESCE(vote_effective_at, vote_completed_at) bigint desc, record_time bigint desc, event_number integer desc)
